changelog:
Initial release of GD&T 标注检查 skill, assisting engineers in completeness and compliance review of GD&T annotations on drawings.

- Generates checklists and issue reports for GD&T marking completeness and conformity, based on ASME Y14.5 / GB standards.
- Identifies missing annotations, datum system errors, and symbol misuse on mechanical drawings.
- Supports multiple user roles (design, process, quality engineers) and common use cases (pre-release review, supplier drawing audit, FAI preparation).
- Clearly defines capabilities and boundaries: focuses on annotation-level checks, does not replace measurement or CAD-based validation.
- Delivers output as both plain text and Markdown, including actionable checklists and issue lists for direct use in review processes.
summary: 图纸 GD&T（几何尺寸与公差）标注完整性与合规性检查助手；基于 ASME Y14.5 / GB 几何公差领域知识生成检查表与问题清单，定位缺漏、基准体系错误与符号误用。
